findings.title: General Findings
findings.details: Extra-axial spaces normal for age. Intracranial hemorrhage absent. Ventricular system normal for age. Basal cisterns, cerebral parenchyma, midline, brainstem, calvarium, paranasal sinuses, mastoid air cells, visualized orbits, and upper cervical spine normal.

findings.title: Abnormalities
findings.details: Abnormal enhancement in right cavernous sinus, foramen rotundum, and foramen ovale. Enhancement and enlargement of right inferior alveolar nerve. Right-sided denervation atrophy of muscles of mastication.

findings.title: Trigeminal Nerve
findings.details: Vascular loop absent. Posterior fossa mass absent. Abnormal enhancement in perineural areas.

impression: Abnormal enhancement and denervation linked to perineural spread of tumor from skin cancer.
notes: Patient demographics, study date, and modality are missing. Some anatomical locations are detailed without measurements.
